pairs.subject: cost-metering
pairs.evidence: src/stores/authStore.ts:215 This context's only outbound calls are Supabase auth calls (getSession at :130, onAuthStateChange at :155, signInWithOAuth at :215, signOut at :255). None of them is billed per unit to the product, and a case-insensitive search of all 8 context files for cost|budget|spend|price|ledger|billing found no hits, so the subject's precondition (a metered call to price, record, attribute or cap) does not hold here.
